Use only owned build definitions and resource-only published JARs. Disable Scala artifact cross names where appropriate. Never execute resolved package code.

sbt.placement: Four separate GitHub Linux jobs with real PostgreSQL, 60-minute job budget; five-minute cold tool bootstrap and two-minute project commands. No real local SBT execution.
sbt.cache_contract: Freeze bounded boot/tool inventories before fixture creation. Every project command receives independent copied tool cache and private Ivy cache with no sbtproof coordinates; one explicit cratectl read source and separate explicit publication URL. Copy proof bytes outside the disposable cache, then remove only that exact cache. Launcher and owned metaproject use the official tool source without registry credentials; global repository override false, plugin resolver inheritance disabled. Both root externalResolvers/csrResolvers must equal the exact sole package endpoint at runtime before every journey command. Resource-only package projects use managedScalaInstance=false; bootstrap/metaproject retain normal tool compilation. Native guard requires allDependencies to equal libraryDependencies and contain only owned fixture coordinates.
sbt.version_api: SBT1 uses File and separate CLI command arguments. SBT2 uses FileConverter for VirtualFileRef artifact paths and HashedVirtualFileRef classpaths, an uncached proof task and one semicolon-delimited command argument. No compatibility plugin or uploaded code executes.
